trap.label: sujeito nulo
trap.wrong: We chose it not because it is cheap but because is reliable.
trap.right: We chose it not because it is cheap but because it is reliable.
trap.why: O português omite o sujeito (“porque é confiável”). Em inglês, o sujeito é obrigatório em toda oração, mesmo depois de but.

mcq.q: “Not X but Y” puts the stress on...

fix.wrong: Is not so much a rule as a habit.
fix.right: It is not so much a rule as a habit.

fix.wrong: They use a term bank for preferred term.
fix.right: They use a term bank for preferred terms.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com not so much…as: “It is a habit more than a rule.”
rewrite.answer: It is not so much a rule as a habit.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com not…but: “They helped, and it was not because it was perfect.” (Not because it is perfect but because they helped)
rewrite.answer: Not because it is perfect but because they helped.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com less…than: “It is more social than technical.”
rewrite.answer: It is less technical than social.
